name: Watchtower
description: A 2 × 2 guard tower that the king can climb. Candidate replacement for the procedural Stone Tower.

variants.name: Square stone keep
variants.notes: Closest to the current tower: square shaft, crenellated platform, one torch by the door.

variants.name: Tripo stone tower
variants.notes: Owner 20 Nov 2026: 3D model generated by the owner in Tripo (watchtower_v1.glb), rendered by Blender in the game projection and sun; the door faces front-left (turned 90°). The game also uses the same render turned to 180° (door right) and 270° (no door). Owner: “je to dobrý”, stone colour kept for walls and gate. v2 (owner 21 Nov 2026, "věž a bránu klidně vyrenderuj znovu pokud to bude lepší"): the foot of the model stretched to cover its 2 × 2 tiles exactly, so walls meet it with no gap.
